evals.name: create-no-site-full
evals.prompt: We're launching Pedalka, a cargo-bike delivery co-op in Istanbul that brings goods from wholesalers to small neighbourhood shops. No website yet. We need the whole identity: logo, fonts and colour palette, and I'd like three directions to compare. The brand writes in Turkish and English, and our app is full of delivery times and prices. Audience: shop owners, mostly over 40. Three words: quick, neighbourly, sturdy. Competitors (names only, don't look them up): Kargoist, Yoldaş Kurye, BiKurye - all of them use a red or orange arrow.
evals.expected_output: init with en+tr and --numbers, one sets.json with three sets, logos then build, review.png looked at, board + review + table written, AI-default flags justified or one default-free set, checkpoint message per set, then a stop: no kit.
expectations: brand.py init ran with Turkish and English languages and --numbers
One sets.json holds three sets, each with a one-sentence mechanism
brand.py logos ran before brand.py build, and review.png was looked at
board.png, review.png and table.md exist in the work folder
Every defaults_used[] entry has a non-empty brief-grounded why, and at least one set is free of AI defaults (or its matches are justified)
Each set says where it differs from Kargoist, Yoldaş Kurye and BiKurye
One set is marked recommended; the reply ends by asking the user to pick
No kit/ folder and no brand.py kit run before the pick

evals.name: create-site-keep-logo
evals.prompt: We're Mulberry, a third-wave coffee shop. Our site is `site/index.html` (a local file, do not go online). Keep our logo exactly as it is - `site/logo.svg` - but we want new fonts and a new colour palette that fit it: warm, but not the cliché coffee brown. Three directions please, shown on our site. English only; the menu shows prices.
evals.expected_output: init with logo=keep, site extract on the local file (no live competitor run), new type and palette built around the mark, site previews, board/review/table, the logo file byte-identical afterwards, checkpoint and stop.
expectations: brand.py init used --state logo=keep
brand.py site extract ran on the local file; no live competitor run
site/logo.svg is byte-identical after the run (same sha256) and was never written or edited
sets.json contains no new symbol_svg; the kept mark is used as-is
table.md has Type and Palette columns and no Logo column
Site previews (PNG) exist for the sets
At least one direction moves clearly away from coffee brown
No kit before the user picks

evals.name: type-only
evals.prompt: We only need typography, nothing else. Ledgerline is a bookkeeping app for freelancers; the interface is in German, Turkish and English and it is full of figures (invoices, tax totals). Logo and colours are not part of this job - leave them out. Give me three font directions: a display face for headings and a text face for the interface.
evals.expected_output: init with logo and palette set to none (or keep), --numbers and de+tr+en languages, a font search, three type sets with no symbols, table.md with only the Type component column, coverage and tabular figures reported, checkpoint and stop.
expectations: brand.py init set logo and palette to none (or keep), with --numbers and de, tr, en languages
brand.py fonts search ran
sets.json has no symbol SVGs; no logo or palette is proposed
table.md has only the Type component column (Set · Mechanism · Type · Where it differs · Risks / flags)
German and Turkish coverage and tabular figures are reported as measured results
Each family's licence or source is stated
No kit before the user picks

evals.name: palette-only-with-existing-logo
evals.prompt: We're Logline, a log search tool for developers. Our page is `site/index.html` (colours are CSS custom properties in :root; local file, do not go online). The logo `brand/logo.svg` stays exactly as it is and we keep our system fonts. We only want a new colour palette: every dev tool is blue and we get lost in the sea of blue. Two directions, shown on the page.
evals.expected_output: init with logo=keep, type kept or none, --sets 2; no font search; two built palettes; table with only the Palette column; the kept logo file byte-identical; checkpoint and stop.
expectations: brand.py init used logo=keep, type=keep (or none) and --sets 2
No font search ran
brand/logo.svg and site/index.html are unchanged
Both sets have a built palette.json (scales and modes)
table.md has only the Palette component column
At least one direction leaves plain category blue, with the reason stated
Contrast is given as ratios; no 'converts' or 'builds trust' claims
No kit before the user picks

evals.name: refresh-logo
evals.prompt: Kestrel is a same-day courier in Leeds. Our logo `brand/kestrel-logo.svg` is from 2011: people know the bird, but the gradient swoosh and the drop shadow feel dated. Refresh the logo and keep what people recognise. Our colours stay as they are (navy #1d3557 and signal orange #e76f51); a new typeface for the wordmark is fine. Three options, English only.
evals.expected_output: init with logo=refresh, symbols drawn as primitives in sets.json (no <text>), logos run and the contact sheet looked at, build, the original SVG untouched, the given colours kept in the palettes, checkpoint and stop.
expectations: brand.py init used --state logo=refresh
Symbols are drawn in sets.json from primitives, with no <text>
brand.py logos ran and logo-sheet.png was looked at
brand/kestrel-logo.svg is unchanged
The palettes keep #1d3557 and #e76f51
Each option says what equity it keeps (the bird) and what it drops (gradient, swoosh, shadow)
No kit before the user picks

evals.name: mix-sets
evals.prompt: We looked at the three Ferrow directions in `brand-identity/ferrow/`. I like the logo and the fonts of A (Spoke Line) but the colours of B (Workshop Ledger). Can you put that combination together so I can see it next to the others?
evals.expected_output: brand.py mix with A:logo, A:type and B:palette into a new set, board re-rendered, cohesion warning reported, no hand-edited sets.json, no kit before the user confirms.
expectations: brand.py mix ran with A:logo, A:type and B:palette into a new set
brand.py init did not run and sets.json was not rewritten by hand
The new set's identity.json and a re-rendered board.png exist
The reply reports the logo recoloured to B's palette, the measured checks and the mixed-set cohesion warning
No kit before the user confirms

evals.name: kit-after-approval
evals.prompt: We went through the three Ferrow directions in `brand-identity/ferrow/` together and I pick A, Spoke Line. Build the brand guidelines kit for it.
evals.expected_output: brand.py kit on sets/A only: PDF, page PNGs, logo files, tokens, fonts.md with licences and no font files; the reply says where everything is and reports the kit gates.
expectations: brand.py kit ran on sets/A only
kit/ferrow-guidelines.pdf, kit/pages/*.png, kit/logo/, kit/tokens/tokens.css and kit/fonts.md exist
fonts.md names the licences; no font files are shipped in kit/
No Pantone or CMYK values are invented
The reply says where each output is and reports the kit gates

evals.name: critique-identity
evals.prompt: Critique our identity without mercy: the site is `site/index.html` (local, do not go online), the logo is `site/logo.svg`, headings are set in Lobster and body text in Lato. We write English and Turkish. I don't want a redesign, just tell me what is broken and what to fix first.
evals.expected_output: brand.py critique with --logo and --fonts (and the site), findings per component with measured contrast ratios, the logo's live <text> flagged, top three measurable fixes, no new identity built, user files untouched.
expectations: brand.py critique ran with --logo and --fonts
No init, logos, build, mix or kit ran (no redesign)
site/ files were not written or edited
Failing colour pairs are named with contrast ratios; no APCA numbers
The logo's live <text> (not outlined) is flagged
Exactly three prioritised, measurable fixes are listed; a refresh is offered, not built

evals.name: fast-intake
evals.prompt: Ich brauche ein Branding für meine Bäckerei.
evals.expected_output: The skill fires and asks one message in German: per component new / refresh / keep / none, number of sets (default 3), site or files, languages, numbers; sector is not asked again. No sets.json written, nothing built.
expectations: The skill fires
One intake message: per component new / refresh / keep / none, number of sets (3 default), site or files, languages
The business type (a bakery) is not asked again
Nothing is built: no sets.json written, no logos, build, mix or kit
The reply is in German
